name: knot
description: Manage knot spaces, templates, stacks and pools, and work with files and commands inside your spaces.
long_description: Connects Claude to your knot server, including one on a private network: the extension runs on your computer and uses the connection set up with knot connect, or a server URL and API token you enter in its settings. Claude gets knot's tools, with the same access as the API token.

alias.title: Connection alias
alias.description: The knot connect connection to use, by its alias in knot.toml. Leave as default for the default connection.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: Optional. Connect to this knot server instead of a knot connect connection; needs an API token too.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Optional. The API token to use with the server URL; a token with only the mcp scope is enough.
